projects.project: Tortunabo — Unreal Engine 5.6 Cooperative Multiplayer Game
projects.purpose: Third-person cooperative racing game for 1–4 players controlling anthropomorphic turtles across procedurally generated level chunks, with networking via Steam Sockets.

memories.title: Project Core Identity
memories.summary: Tortunabo is a cooperative 1–4 player third-person racing game in UE5.6 using Steam Sockets for online multiplayer, with player-controlled anthropomorphic turtles navigating procedurally-generated chunks to reach the finish line.
memories.content: The game combines single-player platforming mechanics with online multiplayer cooperation. Players compete to reach finish lines while collecting items, managing stamina/knockdown states, and reviving downed teammates. Framework splits across three main phases: Menu (LVL_Menu) → Lobby/HQ (LVL_HQ ready-up zone) → Race (LVL_Run with chunk-based procedural generation). Team: USER SURNAME and José Antonio (Mokius). Academic context: T-Day delivery at UNIVERSITY.

memories.title: Modular Multiplayer Architecture
memories.summary: Server-authoritative design using Unreal's replication system (Replicated variables, RPCs) with GameInstance persisting across level transitions and seamless travel between Menu/Lobby/Run phases.
memories.content: UMP_GameInstance (global singleton) manages Steam sessions, cosmetic persistence, tutorial state, and auto-rejoin on connection loss. Game flow controlled via ATN_CoopGameState (replicates MatchFlowState enum: WaitingForPlayers/Countdown/Cinematic/InProgress/Results). Three GameModes coordinate phases: MP_MenuGameMode (menu), TN_HQGameMode (lobby ready-up with countdown), TN_RunGameMode (race logic with DBNO/revive/scoring). OnlineSubsystem plugin enables Steam integration (AppId=480 for testing). Seamless travel avoids loading screens between maps while preserving player connections.

memories.title: Character System — TortugaCharacter
memories.summary: ATortugaCharacter combines third-person camera (SpringArm + FOV interpolation), Enhanced Input, stamina/dive mechanics, inventory (2-slot), knockdown/ragdoll, procedural leg/arm/head animation, emotes (wheel-based), and VOIP proximity component.
memories.content: Core gameplay pawn inheriting ACharacter. Major systems: (1) Movement: walk/sprint via TN_StaminaComponent with weight penalties; dive (air dash with momentum preservation from jump direction; tilt + capsule shrink; momentum factors for alignment to look direction). (2) Knockdown: 180° mesh tilt (Rota B) or full ragdoll with physics if PhysicsAsset present; bleedout timer + revive immunity. (3) Inventory: TN_InventoryComponent with 2 slots (equipped visible on socket; stored invisible); weight affects stamina. (4) Emotes: replicable wheel (0-9 keys); procedural bone rotations (arms/tail/head) driven per-frame; auto-blend-out after emote ends. (5) Camera: cinematic AAA-style with dynamic arm length/FOV during sprint, lag interpolation, floor clamp (CAM-01 prevents ground clip). (6) Animation: procedural pendulum legs (Pata1/Pata2) with walk/sprint frequencies; arm swings; head follow with neck-bone workaround for skinning discontinuity. (7) VOIP: ProximityVoiceComponent attached as child; proximity attenuation matches chat range (inner 300cm full vol, outer 2500cm fade).

memories.title: Procedural Level Generation — TN_ChunkManager
memories.summary: Server-only chunk spawner that maintains a FIFO buffer of 5 ahead + 1 behind, selecting chunks from Easy/Medium/Hard pools based on PassedChunkCount thresholds or custom difficulty sequence, with InSocket/OutSocket alignment for seamless chain.
memories.content: ATN_ChunkManager spawns aligned chunks as players advance. Each chunk Blueprint has three named components: 'InSocket' (entry point), 'OutSocket' (exit point), 'EndTrigger' (BoxComponent detecting player passage). Difficulty progression: chunks 0..EasyToMediumThreshold-1 use Easy pool; EasyToMediumThreshold..MediumToHardThreshold-1 use Medium; MediumToHardThreshold+ use Hard. Mode toggle: bUseRandomGeneration selects pools by index-based thresholds, or CustomChunkSequence array prescribes difficulty per chunk. When PassedChunkCount reaches TotalChunksBeforeFinal (default 10), FinalChunk spawns (must contain TN_FinishLineVolume). CleanupChunks() removes oldest chunks to maintain buffer. InSocket cache avoids repeatedly spawning temps to measure socket offsets. KeepAhead=5, KeepBehind=1 prevents aggressive culling. bDebugDrawSockets visualizes spawning logic.

memories.title: Game Flow & DBNO/Revive System
memories.summary: TN_RunGameMode orchestrates race: countdown → in-progress race with DBNO bleedout timers → results screen with scoreboard → seamless travel back to Lobby. Scoring: RankScore (podium 400/300/200/100/50) + ScorePickups + TimeBonus.
memories.content: PostLogin spawns players at PlayerStart. HandleStartingNewPlayer applies cosmétics. MarkPlayerFinished increments FinishRank and transitions to Results when all finish or eliminate. MarkPlayerDead puts player in spectator + spawns TN_RescuePickup at location (teammate picks it up to revive). EnterDBNO starts bleedout timer (DBNOBleedoutSeconds=8s, server-driven tick). RevivePlayer restores pawn possession + grants ReviveImmunitySeconds (2s) to prevent re-death in death zones. IsPlayerReviveImmune checked by TN_DeathZoneVolume. Scoring: RankScore by podium position (1st=400, 2nd=300, etc.); ScorePickups tallied from pickups collected; TimeBonus = max(0, (TimeBonusBaseline - FinishTime) × PointsPerSecond). FinalScore = RankScore + ScorePickups + TimeBonus replicated in FTN_RaceResultEntry. Results screen shows scoreboard for ResultsDurationSeconds (8s), then seamless travel to LobbyMapPath. PostSeamlessTravel waits for all players (WaitingForPlayersTimeout=15s) before next countdown.

memories.title: Player State & Cosmetics Persistence
memories.summary: TN_CoopPlayerState replicates per-player flow state and cosmetics (helmet/skin). UTN_CosmeticSaveGame persists unlockedHelmets, equippedHelmet, equippedSkin, and accumulatedScore to disk.
memories.content: FTN_HelmetData and FTN_SkinData structs define cosmetic properties (name, rarity, mesh, material). CosmeticSaveGame loaded in UMP_GameInstance::Init() and reapplied to new pawns via ATortugaCharacter::BeginPlay (caches DefaultMaterials, attaches HelmetMeshComp to 'Sombrero' socket, applies skin materials to SkeletalMesh slots). Score accumulates across runs and persists. TN_TutorialSaveGame tracks tutorial completion flag. Menu uses TN_CosmeticsMenuWidget to grid display unlockedHelmets with equip/unequip buttons. Cosmetics apply both at BeginPlay and when PlayerState replicates (OnRep_PlayerState handles race-time cosmetic syncing on latecomer clients).

memories.title: Interaction & World Objects
memories.summary: ATN_InteractableBase and subclasses (Pickups, Directs) provide common interface (CanInteract/Interact). World contains ~39 gameplay actor types: enemies (Crab, Seagull, Jellyfish), obstacles (BananaPeel, BreakablePlatform), collectibles (ScorePickup, ConchPickup, RescuePickup), hazards (DeathZone, SlowZone, StormVolume), mechanics (Totem, UmbrellaInteractable, ButtonInteractable, PressurePlate).
memories.content: ATN_InteractableBase (abstract) provides: CanInteract(APawn*) override point, Interact(APawn*) entry, prompt widget (3D positioned via WidgetComponent), InteractionDistance (default 250cm). Subclasses: ATN_PickupInteractableBase (for item pickups; auto-spawns visual mesh from inventory item), ATN_DirectInteractableBase (for buttons/stations). Notable world actors: ATN_ScorePickup (collectible for race score), ATN_ConchPickup (special collectible, shell spawn zone), ATN_RescuePickup (spawns on death; revives teammate on interact). Enemies: ATN_CrabActor (walk zones, stun-immune), ATN_EnemySeagull (dynamic spawner, kills if no umbrella), ATN_JellyfishActor (projectile on event). Hazards: ATN_DeathZoneVolume (DBNO countdownreset if not revive-immune), ATN_SlowZoneVolume (speed cap via stamina). Mechanics: ATN_TotemInteractable (consumable storage station), ATN_UmbrellaInteractable (umbrellaprotection flag). ATN_ChunkManager registry (TN_LevelTargetSubsystem) resolves targets by FName tag at runtime.

memories.title: Source Code Structure & Module Layout
memories.summary: Single runtime module 'Tortunabo' (C++) with 73 header files and 69 implementation files organized into Public/{Core,Game,Lobby,Menu,Multiplayer,Player,UI,Voice,World} and Private mirrors; integrated plugins: EnhancedInput, OnlineSubsystemSteam, SteamSockets, Niagara.
memories.content: Build.cs dependencies: Core, CoreUObject, Engine, InputCore, EnhancedInput (soft refs for IMC/IA loading), OnlineSubsystem, OnlineSubsystemUtils, UMG (UI widgets), AudioCapture/AudioMixer/SignalProcessing (VOIP), Niagara (VFX). Directory layout: Source/Tortunabo/{Public,Private}/Core (game state/types), Game (run gamemode), Lobby (hq gamemode + ready zone), Menu (menu gamemode + controller), Multiplayer (gameinstance + save games), Player (character + components), UI/{Menu,HUD,Voice} (widgets), Voice (proximity VOIP), World (actors, interactables, enemies). Config/DefaultEngine.ini sets GameInstanceClass, GameDefaultMap (Menu), DefaultGameMode (MenuGameMode), netdriver (SteamSockets fallback IP), and enhanced input defaults. DefaultGame.ini cooks /Game/Maps, /Game/UI, /Game/Input. Entrypoint: LVL_Menu (first map load); listen-server flow: HostSession spawns on LVL_HQ, ServerTravel to LVL_Run seamlessly. No RollingBall module used in Tortunabo main (separate folder structure).

memories.title: Components & Systems
memories.summary: Key components: TN_StaminaComponent (sprint/weight/boost), TN_InventoryComponent (2-slot replication), TN_LegAnimComponent (generic pendulum animation), ProximityVoiceComponent (WASAPI VOIP). Subsystems: TN_LevelTargetSubsystem (actor registry by tag for runtime lookups).
memories.content: TN_StaminaComponent: manages sprint drain (SprintDrainPerSecond), recharge (RechargeDelaySeconds + exponential curve), exhaustion penalty (ExhaustionPenaltySeconds), weight penalty (MaxStamina - TotalWeight × StaminaPerWeightUnit = EffectiveMax), boost (GrantUnlimitedStamina → PostBoostExhaustionSeconds penalty on expiry), speed cap (SetSpeedCap for slow zones). Replicated: CurrentStamina (owner), bIsSprinting/bUnlimitedStamina/bIsExhausted (all). TN_InventoryComponent: 2-slot (EquippedItem visible on socket, StoredItem invisible); RotateItems swaps them; TryAddItem tries equipped then stored; TryConsumeEquippedItem removes + returns item; TryConsumeItemByUseType searches both slots for matching UseType. Weight integration: calcs TotalCarriedWeight, notifies StaminaComponent. TN_LegAnimComponent: generic pendulum sine-wave oscillator (amplitude/frequency) for any limb component, blends in/out on move. ProximityVoiceComponent: WASAPI capture + downsample + Opus compression + multicast to clients within range (inner/outer radius). TN_LevelTargetSubsystem: world subsystem mapping FName → AActor for chunk-runtime target resolution (e.g., button→door).

memories.title: Content & Asset Organization
memories.summary: Content folder splits Audio, Blueprints (derived GameModes/PCs/Characters/Widgets/DataAssets), Maps (Menu/Lobby/Run folders), Materials, Textures, and Collections for loose asset organization.
memories.content: Key Blueprint hierarchy: BP_GameInstance (inherits UMP_GameInstance), BP_MenuGameMode, BP_HQGameMode, BP_RunGameMode, BP_TortugaCharacter (inherits ATortugaCharacter with 'Sombrero' socket for helmet attachment), BP_MainMenuWidget, TN_CoopFlowHUDWidget, TN_PlayerHUDWidget, TN_CosmeticsMenuWidget. DataAssets: TN_EmoteWheelDataAsset (emote catalog with bone rotations/animation montages), TN_HelmetCrateEntry table (loot weights). Maps: LVL_Menu (editor startup), LVL_HQ (lobby with ready zone), LVL_Run (race with chunk manager + finish line volume). Chunk Blueprint templates placed in pools (EasyChunkClasses, etc.) with InSocket/OutSocket/EndTrigger components. Audio: proximity-attenuated emote/VOIP/revive channels, DBNO heartbeat, revive success cues. Materials: post-process ink overlay, cosmetic skins. Textures: helmets, UI icons. Collections: organize assets by feature (cosmetics, UI, audio, etc.).

memories.title: Current Status & Known Implementation Areas
memories.summary: Project is in final stages (T-Day defense delivery). Core systems implemented: multiplayer networking (Steam), chunk generation, DBNO/revive, cosmetics, procedural animation, emotes, VOIP. README documents setup and configuration validation steps.
memories.content: Confirmed working: Menu → Lobby (ready-up zone) → Run (procedural chunks with difficulty scaling) → Results → return to Lobby flow. Seamless travel between phases. DBNO bleedout timer with revive channel (emote-based). Scoring system with rank/pickups/time bonus. Cosmetics (helmet/skin) persistence across sessions. Procedural leg animation (pendulum). Emotes (replicated wheel 0-9 keys with bone animations). VOIP (proximity-filtered multicast). EnhancedInput (soft-loaded from IMC_Player/IA_*). Setup guide (README) lists prerequisite checks: Config/DefaultEngine.ini (GameInstanceClass, netdriver=SteamSockets, AppId=480), DefaultInput.ini (EnhancedInput classes), DefaultGame.ini (folder cook paths), map structure validation (LVL_Menu/HQ/Run existence and correct GameModes), PlayerStart placement. Known areas for refinement (from context): camera floor clamp (CAM-01), net-lag compensation for interaction distance, ragdoll knockdown physics tuning, post-boost exhaustion multipliers.

memories.title: Modelo de datos SQLite
memories.summary: 3 tablas core: movimientos (id, fecha, descripcion, importe, tipo, categoria, fondo_asociado, sincronizado_notion), fondos (nombre, objetivo_eur, ahorrado_eur, aportacion_mensual, estado), stats_mensuales (mes, total_ingresos, total_gastos, balance, ahorro_total).
memories.content: Tabla movimientos: almacena transacciones del banco con id único (hash), fecha, descripción, importe (positivo=ingreso, negativo=gasto), tipo (ingreso|gasto|transferencia), categoría auto-asignada, fondo_asociado opcional, flag sincronizado_notion para tracking Notion. Tabla fondos: gestiona buckets de ahorro con objetivo €, saldo actual, aportación mensual automática, estado (activo|pausado). Tabla stats_mensuales: agrega datos mensuales para dashboards. Backups automáticos con timestamp en nombre archivo.

memories.title: Integración bancaria: Enable Banking + OAuth
memories.summary: Usa API Enable Banking (PRODUCTION) con OAuth2 para conectar KutxaBank de forma segura; alternativa fallback es import CSV exportado del banco; credenciales en .env: APPLICATION_ID, PRIVATE_KEY_PATH (PEM).
memories.content: sync_kutxabank.py orquesta la sincronización: con --setup realiza OAuth (guarda requisition_id en sesión), sincronización normal es últimos 30 días (flag --days personalizable). Usa JWT firmado con PEM para autenticación. Caché local (kutxabank_cache.json) como respaldo ante errores 429 del banco. Soporta import directo desde CSV. El script también puede mostrar resumen de fondos (--fondos). Integración con Anthropic API opcional para categorización IA si ANTHROPIC_API_KEY está en .env.

memories.title: Categorización de transacciones
memories.summary: Dos estrategias: (1) keyword-matching local en categorizer.py con 16 categorías temáticas predefinidas; (2) IA (Claude/Anthropic) en notion_kutxabank.py si API configurada (fallback a keywords).
memories.content: Categorías: 🛒 Alimentación, 🍽️ Restaurantes, 🚗 Transporte, 📱 Suscripciones, 🏠 Vivienda, 💊 Salud, 🎬 Ocio, 👕 Ropa, ✈️ Viajes, 🎓 Educación, 💳 Comisiones, 🏦 Ahorro, 💼 Nómina, 🎁 Regalos, 💸 Reembolso, ❓ Sin categorizar. categorizer.py (38KB) define diccionario CATEGORIAS con ~150+ keywords de búsqueda por categoría. Fallback por defecto a 'Sin categorizar'. notion_kutxabank.py opcionalmente usa Anthropic para mejora IA considerando importe y descripción. Recategorización manual vía recategorizar.py (actualización bulk de movimientos por ID).

memories.title: Dashboard Streamlit y visualización
memories.summary: dashboard.py (38KB) es la UI interactiva con Plotly; ofrece filtros por período (mes, 3m, 6m, año), métricas KPI, gráficos de gastos por categoría, análisis de fondos, tema dark (brand colors: verde, rojo, azul, ámbar).
memories.content: dashboard.py configura Streamlit con tema oscuro (#070b14 fondo). Muestra: (1) KPI cards para saldo actual, ingresos mes, gastos mes, ahorro % (data-testid styling personalizado); (2) gráficos Plotly con color palette de 10 colores; (3) filtros sidebar PERIODOS = [Este mes, Mes anterior, 3 meses, 6 meses, Este año, Todo]; (4) tablas pandas de movimientos filtradas; (5) análisis de fondos (progreso vs objetivos). Utiliza helper _plot_layout() para layout reusable con colores grid (#1e293b). 16 categorías con emoji. Carga datos de finanzas.db via sqlite3, filtra por fecha en Python con pandas.

memories.title: Integración opcional Notion y wake-up con Tío Gilito
memories.summary: notion_sync.py sincroniza movimientos SQLite → Notion DB si NOTION_SYNC_ENABLED=true en .env; CLAUDE.md activa skill tio-gilito automáticamente (bot financiero especializado) como entrada del proyecto.
memories.content: notion_sync.py (2.2KB) mapea movimientos a propiedades Notion: Descripción (title), Importe (number), Tipo (select: 💰 Ingreso/💸 Gasto/🔄 Transferencia), Categoría (select), Fecha, ID transacción. memories.title: Configuración de fondos y límites mensuales

projects.purpose: Android app for exploring astronomical objects (planets, moons, asteroids) from NASA and Solar System APIs with Firebase auth and SQLite favorites storage

memories.title: Proyecto OrbitalDB is Android/Kotlin, NOT Flutter
memories.summary: OrbitalDB es un proyecto Android nativo escrito en Kotlin (no Dart-Flutter como se especificó inicialmente); ubicado en C:/Users/USER/CARRERA/ASIGNATURAS/AppMoviles/codigo/OrbitalDB
memories.content: El proyecto es una aplicación Android nativa construida con Kotlin que integra APIs de NASA y Solar System para explorar cuerpos celestes. Pese a la especificación inicial de Dart-Flutter, la realidad es Android con Gradle como build system. Target SDK 36, compileSdk 36, minSdk 28.

memories.title: Arquitectura en capas con Service Locator pattern
memories.summary: ServiceLocator.kt actúa como inyector de dependencias manual; separa UI (Fragments + ViewModels), Data (Repositories), y API/DB (Retrofit + SQLite) en capas independientes
memories.content: El patrón singleton ServiceLocator (ServiceLocator.kt) centraliza la creación de repositorios y evita que ViewModels conozcan directamente Retrofit o SQLite. Cada repositorio (ApodRepository, SolarSystemRepository, ObservatoryRepository, NasaImageRepository) maneja su propia lógica de obtención y caché de datos, comunicándose con la capa de datos (APIs o BD). Esta separación permite testear ViewModels sin mocking complejo.

memories.title: Estructura de carpetas y responsabilidades
memories.summary: app/src/main/java/com/example/orbitaldb/ contiene: data/ (APIs y BD), model/ (ObservableItem sealed class), ui/ (Fragments y ViewModels), MainActivity.kt (entry point), OrbitalDbApp.kt, ServiceLocator.kt
memories.content:
Estructura principal:
- MainActivity.kt: Activity única con Navigation Component, setup de bottom nav y toolbar
- OrbitalDbApp.kt: Application class que inicia ServiceLocator
- data/api/: Retrofit services (ApodApiService, SolarSystemApiService, NasaImageApiService) + RetrofitProvider (builder centralizado)
- data/db/: SQLite helper (ObservatoryDbHelper) con tabla 'observed_item' para favoritos
- data/repo/: Repositories encapsulan lógica de Retrofit y BD
- model/: ObservableItem (sealed class) con tres subtipos: Image, News, Body
- ui/fragment/: LoginFragment, RegisterFragment, DiscoverFragment, BodiesFragment, ObservatoryFragment, DetailFragment
- ui/*/: ViewModels y adapters por pantalla

memories.title: Stack tecnológico key

memories.summary: NASA APOD (foto del día), NASA Image Library (búsqueda/metadata), Solar System OpenData (catálogo cuerpos celestes); todas vía Retrofit con retry en ViewModels cuando fallan
memories.content:
APIs:
1. NASA APOD: endpoint /planetary/apod → ApodRepository.today() retorna ObservableItem.Image con foto, descripción y fecha
2. NASA Images: endpoint /search → NasaImageRepository.imageFor(body) resuelve thumbnail para cualquier ObservableItem
3. Solar System OpenData: endpoint /rest/ → SolarSystemRepository.all() retorna lista de cuerpos (planetas, lunas, asteroides) con masa, gravedad, radio

Fljo de datos: ViewModels llaman repositories → repositories usan Retrofit → Retrofit construido por RetrofitProvider (maneja auth bearer token).
Errores: ViewModels catching excepciones y fallando gracefully (mostrar UiState.Error o valores por defecto).

memories.title: Autenticación con Firebase Auth y datos en Realtime Database
memories.summary: LoginFragment y RegisterFragment usan FirebaseAuth.signInWithEmailAndPassword() y createUserWithEmailAndPassword(); datos de usuario guardados en Firebase Realtime Database
memories.content:
Flujo auth:
- LoginFragment: si currentUser != null navega a DiscoverFragment
- signInWithEmailAndPassword() con manejo de callbacks (success → navigate, fail → Snackbar error)
- RegisterFragment: createUserWithEmailAndPassword() similar
- MainActivity.performLogout(): FirebaseAuth.signOut() + navigate a LoginFragment con back stack limpio
- google-services.json incluido (Firebase config API keys)
- Usuarios pueden guardar favoritos en observatorio local; datos de usuario en Firebase (aunque no mostrado en código revisado)

memories.title: ObservatoryDbHelper: SQLite local para favoritos con CRUD ops
memories.summary: Tabla 'observed_item' con campos: external_id, type (IMAGE/NEWS/BODY), title, image_url, description, extra_json (Gson serialized), date_added, user_note; índice en type; UNIQUE constraint (external_id, type)
memories.content:
Esquema DB:
- CREATE TABLE observed_item (local_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, external_id TEXT NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, ...)
- UNIQUE(external_id, type) previene duplicados
- Métodos: insert(ObservedRecord), delete(externalId, type), all() ORDER BY date_added DESC, countByType(), isObserved()
- extra_json almacena el ObservableItem serializado en JSON para reconstruir cualquier tipo (Image/News/Body)
- ObservatoryRepository encapsula y convierte entre ObservedRecord ↔ ObservableItem usando Gson
- No hay migrations, schema version=1

memories.title: UI: 5 Fragments con Navigation Component + bottom nav + adapter patterns
memories.summary: LoginFragment → DiscoverFragment (hub APOD+Body aleatorio) → BodiesFragment (lista filtrable) → DetailFragment (detalle item) → ObservatoryFragment (lista favoritos con swipe-delete); all Fragments en single nav_graph
memories.content:
Fragmentos:
1. LoginFragment/RegisterFragment: auth gates, pre-nav check
2. DiscoverFragment: carga APOD del día + cuerpo aleatorio, botones ver detalle
3. BodiesFragment: RecyclerView con BodiesAdapter, filtro por tipo + búsqueda fulltext
4. DetailFragment: muestra ObservableItem (title, image, description, extra metadata), botón add/remove observatorio
5. ObservatoryFragment: RecyclerView ObservatoryAdapter, swipe LEFT/RIGHT to delete, progress bar, empty label

Navigation: nav_graph.xml define todas acciones con animations (fade_in/fade_out).
UI Binding: view binding en todos fragments (FragmentXxxBinding.inflate).
Adapters: BodiesAdapter, ObservatoryAdapter extienden ListAdapter para diffing eficiente.

memories.title: ViewModels con MutableLiveData<UiState<T>> pattern para loading/success/error
memories.summary: DiscoverViewModel, BodiesViewModel, DetailViewModel, ObservatoryViewModel implementan UiState<T> sealed class (Loading, Success, Error) para manejar async states
memories.content:
Patrón común:
- Private _state = MutableLiveData<UiState<T>>(UiState.Loading)
- Public state: LiveData<UiState<T>> (read-only)
- init { load() } en constructor
- load() → _state.value = UiState.Loading → repository call en viewModelScope.launch → _state.value = UiState.Success/Error
- Fragments observan state y actualizan UI según tipo (binding.progress.visibility, binding.error.text, adapter.submitList)
- BodiesViewModel además: maneja filtering (setFilter, setQuery) sin reload, solo re-emit localmente
- Coroutines Dispatchers.IO en repos, main en ViewModels via viewModelScope

memories.title: Keys técnicas: API key externalized en BuildConfig, no commiteado
memories.summary: NASA_API_KEY y SOLAR_SYSTEM_TOKEN leídas de local.properties en build time via buildConfigField; default DEMO_KEY si no configurado
memories.content:
build.gradle.kts app level:
- Lee local.properties
- nasaKey = localProps.getProperty('nasaApiKey') ?: 'DEMO_KEY'
- solarToken = localProps.getProperty('solarSystemToken') ?: ''
- Inyecta via buildConfigField() en BuildConfig.NASA_API_KEY y BuildConfig.SOLAR_SYSTEM_TOKEN
- RetrofitProvider usa BuildConfig.NASA_API_KEY en ApodApiService queries
- OkHttp interceptor chequea si URL es api.le-systeme-solaire.net y SOLAR_SYSTEM_TOKEN es blank antes de inyectar Bearer header
- local.properties ignorado en .gitignore (seguridad)

memories.title: Entrypoint y init flow
memories.summary: AndroidManifest: android:name=.OrbitalDbApp → onCreate() llama ServiceLocator.init(appContext) → MainActivity launched → nav_graph startDestination=loginFragment
memories.content:
Flujo al iniciar:
1. System crea OrbitalDbApp (extends Application)
2. OrbitalDbApp.onCreate() → ServiceLocator.init(applicationContext)
3. ServiceLocator crea ObservatoryDbHelper singleton
4. MainActivity cargada (action MAIN + LAUNCHER en manifest)
5. MainActivity.onCreate(): setup view binding, NavHostFragment, navigation controller, bottom nav setup
6. nav_graph.xml startDestination = loginFragment
7. Si user ya autenticado en Firebase → LoginFragment.onStart() navega a DiscoverFragment
8. Si no → login/register flow

Actual activity única; todo manejo de vistas vía Navigation Fragments.

projects.purpose: Plataforma web para gestionar un club gastronómico privado: dinners, rankings, votaciones y administración de miembros.

memories.title: Propósito y dominio del proyecto
memories.summary: Niajska es una plataforma web para el Club Niasjka, un grupo privado de amigos que organiza cenas mensuales en restaurantes, votadas y rankings de miembros.
memories.content: El proyecto es una aplicación web para gestionar un club gastronómico cerrado donde: (1) cada miembro organiza una cena en un restaurante diferente durante la temporada (sept-ago), (2) otros miembros votan la experiencia en 7 categorías (calidad, cantidad, RCP, ubicación, originalidad, ambiente, servicio) cada 0-5 puntos, (3) se calcula un ranking final al cierre de temporada, (4) existe un sistema de multas (cuotas anuales, faltas de asistencia), (5) hay roles administrativos (secretario, tesorero). El dominio tiene siglos de historia documentada (datos desde 1996 en PDFs en el raíz).

memories.title: Stack tecnológico y arquitectura frontend
memories.summary: Next.js 16.2 + React 19 + TypeScript + TailwindCSS 4 + Lucide icons; arquitectura App Router con server components/actions.
memories.content: Frontend: Next.js con App Router (no Pages), Server Components por defecto para seguridad y rendimiento. UI: React 19 + TailwindCSS 4 (PostCSS). Tipado: TypeScript estricto. Iconografía: Lucide React. Fuentes: Inter (body), Playfair Display (headers), Cormorant Garamond (alternativa luxe). Testing: Vitest + React Testing Library. Linting: ESLint 9 + Next.js config. PWA: manifest.json + service worker (sw.js) para offline support. El proyecto está optimizado para mobile-first (Max-width 1 línea: max-w-lg mx-auto px-4) como aplicación de club privado.

memories.title: Backend y base de datos: Supabase PostgreSQL
memories.summary: Supabase PostgreSQL con RLS policies, migraciones versionadas, JWT auth, service role para operaciones privilegiadas.
memories.content: Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL managed). Auth: JWT con email sintético interna (player.id@niasjka.internal), bcryptjs para hashing local. Dos clientes: (1) createClient() → anon key + auth context (browser/server components), (2) createServiceClient() → service role key (admin actions, bypass RLS). Migraciones SQL en /supabase/migrations/ con versionado temporal (202604xx_*). Tablas principales: players, seasons, season_players, dinners, dinner_guests, votes, fines, fund_transactions, group_settings. RLS policies en 20260421000003. Bug conocido: GoTrue v2.188.1 null string handling → custom rpc fix_user_null_strings. Índices en patrones comunes (season_id, voter_id, surname/name).

memories.title: Estructura de directorios y responsabilidades
memories.summary: Layout: /app (App Router, 25 pages), /lib (lógica), /components (reusables), /public (PWA assets), /supabase/migrations (schema).
memories.content: Directorio raíz:/app/ → App Router con grupos de ruta. Rutas principales:(1) /(auth) → login/register pages con form actions, (2) /(app) → protected por middleware (requiere user en session). Dentro /(app): inicio (home con pinned announcements), temporada (dinners calendar + history), club (player profiles, badges, rankings), admin/* (secretary-only pages: temporada setup, miembros, multas, fondo, votación, histórico, avisos), tesorero (treasurer fund view), cronicas (chronicles CRUD), perfil (user settings). /lib/:actions/ (9 Server Actions por dominio: auth, season, vote, dinner, admin, absences, chronicles, profile, historico), /queries/ (read-only async fetches), /supabase/ (client, server, types.ts generado), /scoring.ts + .test.ts (vote calculation logic), /badges.ts (achievement computation), /types.ts (type definitions from DB schema). /components/:club/, charts/, cronicas/, layout/, perfil/, temporada/ (domain-organized reusables). /public/:manifest.json, sw.js, icons. /supabase/migrations/ (7 SQL files + data seed dir).

memories.title: Flujo de votación y cálculo de puntuación
memories.summary: 7 categorías votadas 0-5: tres principales (calidad, cantidad, RCP) peso 1x, cuatro secundarias (ubicación, originalidad, ambiente, servicio) peso 0.25x cada una.
memories.content: Vote scoring: calculateScore() en /lib/scoring.ts → (main_avg + additional_avg*0.25) / 4 * 10 / 10 (redondea a 0.1). Main = calidad + cantidad + RCP. Additional = ubicación, originalidad, ambiente, servicio promedio. Rango final: 0–5. ComputeEliminatedScore() en vote.ts: si >3 votos, descarta mínimo y máximo, usa promedio de los medios; si ≤3, usa todos. Unique constraint: una votación por (dinner_id, voter_id). Anfitrión no puede votar su propia cena. Published score almacenado en dinner.published_score (NUMERIC(3,1)).

memories.title: Sistema de badges y logros
memories.summary: 13+ badges dinamisch computados (Leyenda, Veterano, Presidente, Podio, Élite, Superviviente, Remontada, Condenado, Libre de Nevera, Sin Multas, Debut, Cronista, Moroso, La Última Cena).
memories.content: computeBadges() en /lib/badges.ts analiza history (season_players), dinners, fines para asignar iconos Lucide. Ejemplos: 'Leyenda' (≥10 temporadas activas), 'Hat-trick' (≥3 presidentes), 'Élite' (≥16/20 en restaurante), 'Condenado' (≥1 en 'Nevera'/camara), 'Superviviente' (pasó de camara a activo). 'Moroso' flag para cuota anual pendiente. 'La Última Cena' marca jugadores memorial (fallecidos). Usados en perfil de jugador y club rankings.

memories.title: Temporada, Sorteo y Asignaciones
memories.summary: Temporada (sept año N a agosto año N+1), sorteo aleatorio de meses asignados, 3 jugadores en 'Nevera' (camara) por bajo ranking, presidente es top 1.
memories.content: Temporada: año único (e.g., 2024), comienza mes 9 default. Season_players: cada jugador asignado a 1 mes para organizar cena. Status: draft → active → closed. Sorteo (doSorteo): shuffle array, assign meses round-robin a jugadores activos no-camara. Camara: los N jugadores (camara_size, default 3) con peor ranking pasan a 'Nevera' siguiente temporada (is_camara=true). Ranking: calcula tras cerrar temporada, ordena por final_score desc, asigna ranking_position. Presidente: ranking_position=1. Multas: por no presentar restaurante ($fine_amount, default $10), por faltas de asistencia (absences table), por violaciones (registered como 'reason'). Annual_fee: cuota de temporada. Supabase functions + applySorteo server action para aplicar.

memories.title: Entrypoint, auth y protección de rutas
memories.summary: Root / redirige a /login, rutas /(app)/* requieren user en session (verificado en layout.tsx middleware), logout by Supabase auth.
memories.content: app/page.tsx: export default redirect('/login'). app/(auth)/login/page.tsx: form-based login por name+surname+password, busca player activo, verifica bcrypt hash, llama supabase.auth.signInWithPassword(). app/(auth)/register/page.tsx: register action busca player inactivo en base (debe ser creado por secretario previamente), hasheа password, crea auth user, linkea con player.auth_id. app/(app)/layout.tsx: validatega user via supabase.auth.getUser(), redirige a /login si no existe. Protección: server-side en layout, no requiere middleware explícita en Next.js 16 App Router. Logout: botón en UI llama supabase.auth.signOut() (client-side signout action). Session: soporta multidevice via Supabase auth.

memories.title: Características principales implementadas y estado
memories.summary: MVP completo: auth, temporada CRUD, dinners CRUD + votación, club view, admin tools (multas, miembros, fondo), cronicas, ausencias; tests para scoring/seasons.
memories.content: Funcionalidades: (✓) Autenticación name/surname/password, (✓) Crear temporada + setup (year, camara_size, montos), (✓) Sorteo automático de meses, (✓) Crear cena (host, restaurante, fecha), (✓) Abrir/cerrar votación, (✓) Votar cena (7 categorías), (✓) Calcular ranking, (✓) Historial de temporadas pasadas, (✓) Perfil jugador con badges, (✓) Club view (rankings históricos, comparación, participación), (✓) Admin miembros (toggle activo), (✓) Multas CRUD, (✓) Fondo/tesorería, (✓) Ausencias, (✓) Crónicas del club (notas y avisos), (✓) PWA con SW, (✓) UI responsiva Tailwind. Tests: scoring.test.ts, seasons.test.ts (vitest). PDFs históricos (1996–2025) en raíz como reference data. Lint + format: eslint con config Next.js.

memories.title: Decisiones de seguridad y estilo de datos
memories.summary: RLS en todas las tablas (usuarios ven solo datos no-sensibles + propios), service role para admin, bcryptjs local + Supabase auth, JWT internal.
memories.content: Seguridad: (1) RLS policies aseguran jugadores activos solo leen public data + own profile, secretarios pueden write season/admin, (2) server actions ejecutan con service role para operaciones privilegiadas, (3) bcryptjs hashing local + Supabase JWT para auth, (4) email sintética interna (no expone dominio externo), (5) CORS/CSRF mitigado por Next.js/Supabase defaults, (6) .env.local contiene keys, .gitignore lista sensibles. Estilo datos: temporada de sept a agosto (fiscal del club, no calendárico), Nevera = camara = last places, presidente = top 1, scoring 0–5 con decimales 0.1, multas in EUR/USD. Nombres en español para dominio específico (cena, temporada, cronicas, multa, nevera, tesorero, sorteo).

projects.purpose: Juego puzzle basado en turnos en Unity donde un jugador navega una grid evadiendo un enemigo IA y llegando a una zona objetivo, con sistema de energía y undo de movimientos.

memories.title: Patrón Singleton thread-safe para GameManager
memories.summary: GameManager implementa Singleton con lock para evitar race conditions; crea instancia automáticamente si no existe y nunca se destruye entre escenas (DontDestroyOnLoad).
memories.content: El GameManager usa un patrón Singleton con sincronización thread-safe mediante 'lock(_lock)' y un flag '_applicationIsQuitting' para evitar crear instancias durante shutdown. FindFirstObjectByType busca instancia existente; si no hay, crea un GameObject con componente y lo marca como DontDestroyOnLoad. Este es el centro de orquestación del estado del juego.

memories.title: Estructura de Scripts por responsabilidad
memories.summary: Código organizado en: Managers (GameManager), Commands (ICommand, MoveCommand, CommandInvoker), AI (EnemyAI), UI (UIManager), y entidades (PlayerController, GoalZone).
memories.content: Directorio Assets/GameAssets/Scripts contiene: /Managers/GameManager.cs (orquestación), /Commands/ con patrón Command (ICommand interface, MoveCommand concreto, CommandInvoker para historial y undo), /AI/EnemyAI.cs (persecución del jugador), /UI/UIManager.cs (HUD con energía/turnos), PlayerController.cs (input y movimiento), GoalZone.cs (detección de victoria). Arquitectura escalable por capas.

memories.title: Patrón Command para movimientos con undo
memories.summary: Movimientos del jugador se encapsulan en MoveCommand que almacena posición anterior, costo de energía, y permite deshacer guardando historial en Stack en CommandInvoker.
memories.content: MoveCommand implementa ICommand con Execute() que resta energía del GameManager y mueve transform, e Undo() que restaura posición y energía. CommandInvoker mantiene Stack<ICommand> que crece con cada movimiento. PlayerController presiona Z para llamar CommandInvoker.UndoLastCommand(). Esto permite rewind perfecto del estado sin snapshots.

memories.title: Sistema de energía y restricciones de movimiento
memories.summary: Jugador comienza con 10 energía; cada movimiento cuesta 1; sin energía suficiente falla el movimiento y se dispara GameOver automáticamente.
memories.content: GameManager.Energy es property con getter/setter que valida: Energy -= amount clampea a 0, invoca OnEnergyChanged event, y si llega a 0 desencadena TriggerGameOver(). PlayerController.TryMove() primero valida HasEnoughEnergy(1) antes de ejecutar MoveCommand. ConsumeEnergy devuelve bool para validación. UIManager suscrito a OnEnergyChanged actualiza TextMeshProUGUI y Slider en tiempo real.

memories.title: IA del enemigo persigue con pathfinding en grid
memories.summary: EnemyAI se mueve 2 casillas por turno del jugador usando raycast para detectar obstáculos; prioriza dirección horizontal vs vertical según distancia al jugador.
memories.content: EnemyAI suscrito a OnTurnEnded ejecuta CalculateAndMove() que: 1) calcula vector hacia PlayerController, 2) GetPrioritizedDirections() retorna array de Vector3 en orden (horizontal primero si dist.x > dist.z), 3) IsPathClear() usa raycast contra obstacleLayer, 4) PerformMovement() interpola smooth (moveSpeed=5). Colisión directa con jugador o proximidad <0.6 dispara TriggerGameOver(). Reutiliza gridSize=1.2 como PlayerController.

memories.title: Sistema de eventos Observer para comunicación entre sistemas
memories.summary: GameManager dispara 6 eventos (OnEnergyChanged, OnTurnEnded, OnGameOver, OnGameWon, OnGameRestarted, CommandInvoker.OnCommandExecuted/Undone) que UIManager, PlayerController, EnemyAI y GoalZone suscriben.
memories.content: GameManager define event Action<int> OnEnergyChanged, Action OnTurnEnded, OnGameOver, OnGameWon, OnGameRestarted. UIManager y otros componentes suscriben en Initialize() y desuscriben en OnDestroy() para evitar memory leaks. Esto desacopla la lógica de juego de la presentación. CommandInvoker también dispara OnCommandExecuted/Undone para potencial logging.

memories.title: Condiciones de victoria y derrota
memories.summary: Victoria: jugador entra a GoalZone (detección by proximity <1.5 o OnTriggerEnter). Derrota: energía llega a 0 o colisiona con enemigo.
memories.content: GoalZone.Update() chequea distancia <detectionRadius (1.5) y llama GameManager.TriggerVictory(). También usa OnTriggerEnter como respaldo. EnemyAI dispara TriggerGameOver() en CheckPlayerCollision() (OnCollisionEnter/OnTriggerEnter) y CheckPlayerProximity() if distance<0.6. GameManager.Energy property automáticamente invoca TriggerGameOver si _energy<=0. El estado _isGameOver previene múltiples triggers.

memories.title: Controles e interacción del jugador
memories.summary: Movimiento: WASD o flechas en grid con detección de colisiones por raycast. Undo: Z. Obstáculos validados antes de ejecutar comando.
memories.content: PlayerController.HandleMovementInput() chequea Input.GetKeyDown para W/UpArrow/S/DownArrow/A/LeftArrow/D/RightArrow. TryMove(direction) valida energía, calcula targetPosition = transform.position + direction*gridSize (1.2), y IsPathClear() raycast contra obstacleLayer con distancia 1.2 (matching gridSize). Si clear, ExecuteMoveCommand(). Undo binding a Z llama CommandInvoker.UndoLastCommand() si CanUndo. OnDrawGizmosSelected() visualiza los 4 raycast direccionales para debug.

memories.title: Versión de Unity y dependencias de compilación
memories.summary: Proyecto compilado con Unity 6000.0.60f1 (LTS), .NET Framework 4.7.1, C# 9.0; depende de TextMeshPro, input system legacy y nuevo, y physics 3D.
memories.content: Assembly-CSharp.csproj especifica: TargetFrameworkVersion v4.7.1, LangVersion 9.0, PlattformStandalone Windows. Define símbolos para UNITY_6000_0, UNITY_STANDALONE_WIN, soporte para managed jobs, TextCore 1.0+, directx. Assembly-CSharp-Editor es proyecto separado para scripts de editor. Escena principal es Assets/GameAssets/Scenes/SampleScene.unity sin escenas adicionales en build (solo 1 enabled en EditorBuildSettings).

projects.purpose: A first-person stealth game built in Unreal Engine 5.6 where the player is a thief stealing coins from a village while avoiding guards and villagers.

memories.title: Project Technology Stack
memories.summary: UE5.6 C++ with Enhanced Input System, Behavior Trees, AI Perception, and Niagara particles; target is Runtime module with Editor-only plugins.
memories.content: TheThief is built on Unreal Engine 5.6 (EngineAssociation: 5.6). The project uses a single Runtime module named 'TheThief' with public dependencies: Core, CoreUObject, Engine, InputCore, EnhancedInput, AIModule, GameplayTasks, NavigationSystem, Niagara, UMG, Slate, SlateCore. Enabled plugins: ModelingToolsEditorMode (Editor-only) and GameplayStateTree. The codebase is C++ with significant Blueprint implementation for AI behavior trees, characters, and UI widgets.

memories.title: Project Source Architecture
memories.summary: Source code organized in Public/Private split with AI, Characters, Components, Game, Items, Player, and UI subsystems; 51 total header files across modular structure.
memories.content: The Source/TheThief folder follows standard UE structure with Public (interfaces and declarations) and Private (implementations). Major subsystems: AI (BaseEnemy, GuardCharacter, VillagerCharacter, EnemyController with BehaviorTree support), Characters (BaseCharacter abstract base with health/damage), Player (ShooterCharacter as AThiefCharacter, ShooterController), Game (ThiefGameMode with state machine, ThiefGameInstance, VillagerManager, MainMenuGameMode), Components (custom gameplay mechanics), Items (interactive objects), Animations, and UI (various widgets). AI subsystem further organized with Decorators, Services, and Tasks for BehaviorTree nodes.

memories.title: Character Hierarchy and Health System
memories.summary: Abstract ABaseCharacter extends ACharacter with health, damage direction calculation, hit reactions, ragdoll, and callbacks for subclass customization (ABaseEnemy, AThiefCharacter).
memories.content: BaseCharacter is the root abstraction providing common combat mechanics: MaxHealth/Health properties, TakeDamage override with direction calculation (Front/Back/Left/Right), hit animations per direction (HitFrontMontage, HitBackMontage, etc.), and ragdoll activation after death animation. Virtual OnDeath() and OnHitReaction() callbacks allow ABaseEnemy and AThiefCharacter to override behavior. DeathAnimationDuration controls ragdoll timing. This design centralizes damage and animation logic while allowing NPCs and player to specialize their responses.

memories.title: Guard AI System
memories.summary: AGuardCharacter uses EnemyController with BehaviorTree to manage patrol/investigate/chase/attack states; includes voice lines, weapon socket attachment, and capture detection.
memories.content: AGuardCharacter (extends ABaseEnemy) manages guard-specific behavior via CurrentState (EGuardState: Patrol, Investigate, Chase, Attack). Uses AEnemyController which initializes BehaviorTree (configurable property), AIPerceptionComponent for player detection (SightRadius=1500, PeripheralVisionAngle=70), and implements OnTargetPerceptionUpdated callback. Speed varies: PatrolSpeed=200, ChaseSpeed=450. Features CaptureRange for proximity-based capture, AlertRadius for nearby guard coordination, dynamic widget icon display (ENPCWidgetIcon), voice lines during chase with pitch variation, and weapon mesh attachment via WeaponSocket. Behavior Tree nodes are custom C++ tasks/decorators for specific guard behaviors.

memories.title: Villager AI System
memories.summary: AVillagerCharacter inherits BaseEnemy with EVillagerState (Walking/Talking/Fleeing/AlertingGuard), coin holding, and witness-to-crime mechanics with guard escalation.
memories.content: Villagers are NPCs that can be robbed or killed, triggering alarm behaviors. EVillagerState manages idle walking (WalkSpeed=150), talking to other villagers (TalkDistance=200, IdleTimeToTalk=0.5s), fleeing (FleeSpeed=300, FleeDuration=5s), and alerting guards. Core feature: bHasCoin flag controls which villagers can be robbed; AVillagerManager distributes coins randomly at level start (NumVillagersWithCoins configurable). Crime witness system: WitnessRadius=800 for detecting theft; villagers alert nearby guards via AlertGuards(), with coordination to prevent multiple alerts for same thief (CurrentAlertedThief static). Panic and talk sounds with pitch variation. Villager statuses display via StatusWidget with icon reflecting state (None/Alert/AlertWithCoin).

memories.title: Player Character (AThiefCharacter) Mechanics
memories.summary: Player is AThiefCharacter (extends BaseCharacter) with Sprint/Combat/Steal/Stealth states, coin collection, witness detection, and interaction with Enhanced Input.
memories.content: AThiefCharacter drives core gameplay: Movement (WalkSpeed=300, SprintSpeed=600, bIsSprinting flag), Combat (AttackMontages array, combo system with per-attack socket selection, AttackDamage=100, AttackRange=150, AttackRadius=80), Interaction (InteractionRange=100, StealRange=200 for nearby villager theft), and Stealth (bIsHidden, bIsStealing, bIsCommittingCrime for witness mechanics). Delegates signal state changes: OnCoinsChanged, OnPlayerCaptured, OnPlayerWon. Input via Enhanced Input System: MoveAction, LookAction, JumpAction, SprintAction, AttackAction, InteractAction, PauseAction. Stealth state: SeenByCount tracks enemies seeing player; IsBeingSeen() returns true if SeenByCount>0. Win condition: CollectedCoins >= RequiredCoins (default 10). Death triggers CapturedMontage, ragdoll, and level restart timer (RestartLevelAfterDeath). Witness alert system: AlertNearbyWitnesses() alerts within WitnessAlertRange (default 1500), optional LineOfSight requirement.

memories.title: Game State and Flow Management
memories.summary: AThiefGameMode (extends GameModeBase) manages EThiefGameState (MainMenu/Playing/Paused/Won/Captured) with UI widget system and audio pitch modulation.
memories.content: ThiefGameMode defines game state machine and lifecycle: bStartWithMainMenu (default true) shows MainMenu before gameplay. SetGameState() broadcasts OnGameStateChanged event and manages widget visibility: MainMenuWidgetClass, HUDWidgetClass, PauseMenuWidgetClass, GameEndWidgetClass. Menu system: bSkipMainMenu allows dev bypass; MenuCameraTag ('MenuCamera') identifies camera for menu view; SwitchToMenuCamera/SwitchToPlayerCamera controls viewport. Ambient audio system: AmbientSoundsToPlay array plays during level; pitch lerping on game state changes (CapturedPitchTarget=0.5 on capture, PitchLerpSpeed=1.0). Coin registration: RegisterCoin/UnregisterCoin updates TotalCoinsInLevel for level completion tracking. Flow: StartGame → TogglePause/ResumeGame → OnPlayerCaptured/OnPlayerWon → GoToMainMenu → RestartGame/QuitGame.

memories.title: Interaction System and Interfaces
memories.summary: IInteractable interface (blueprintable) defines Interact(), GetInteractionPrompt(), and CanInteract() for objects; player checks InteractionRange to show prompts.
memories.content: IInteractable is a minimal interface with three blueprint-native event functions: Interact(AActor* Interactor) for action execution, GetInteractionPrompt() returning FText display, and CanInteract(AActor* Interactor) for conditional availability. AThiefCharacter.PerformInteractionCheck() uses SweepSingleByChannel over InteractionRange to find interactable objects and display prompts via InteractionPromptWidget. This allows coins, doors, chests, and other level objects to implement custom interaction logic via Blueprint without code changes.

memories.content: Content/Blueprints/ organizes game classes: BP_ThiefController, BP_ThiefGameMode, Enemy folder with animation blueprints (ABP_Guard, ABP_Village, BS_Guard, BS_Npcs blend spaces), animation montages (AM_Guard, AM_HitFront/Back/Left/Right), and UI widgets. memories.title: Behavior Tree Task/Decorator Architecture for AI
memories.summary: Custom C++ BT nodes (Decorators: CanSeeTarget/GuardStateCheck/VillagerStateCheck/IsInCaptureRange; Services: UpdateTargetLocation/CheckVisibility/SetFocusOnTarget/SetNewSpeed; Tasks: 20+ custom tasks) enable reusable, testable AI logic.

Decorators (btask_guard/villager state checks) gate execution. Services (ongoing context updates like target location refresh, focus management). Tasks (discrete actions: GuardAlertNearby, GuardInvestigateArea, GuardSetState, GuardWait, VillagerAlertGuard, VillagerFleeFrom, VillagerFindNearestGuard, VillagerTalk, Attack, CapturePlayer, FleeFromLocation, etc.). This modular approach centralizes complex decisions in code while keeping the BT asset as a readable orchestration layer.

projects.purpose: Third-person action game with combo-based combat, enemy AI with two-circle group tactics, grapple mechanic, clone teleport, and ultimate laser ability.

memories.title: Core Game Loop and Mechanics
memories.summary: Third-person action game with light/heavy combo attacks, parry system inspired by Sekiro, targeting and grapple mechanic, clone teleport, and ultimate 5-second laser after 4 kills.
memories.content: SairanSkies is a UE5.6 action game where the player controls Sairan with a greatsword and multiple abilities. Core gameplay: (1) Light Attack - 5-hit combo with precise parry windows, (2) Heavy Attack - chargeable with variable damage, (3) Targeting - auto-snap to nearest enemy within radius (Arkham-style), (4) Grapple - aim and latch onto tagged objects with impulse and double-jump reset, (5) Clone - place clone at current position then teleport back (contextual distance for combat vs exploration), (6) Ultimate - fill XP bar by killing enemies (25 XP per kill, 4 kills = full) then activate 5-second laser that damages everything in its path. Combat emphasizes parrying: successful parry triggers slow-motion freeze frame (like God of War 2018), perfect parry deflects and applies bonus damage.

memories.title: Architecture: Component-Based Design Centered on Character
memories.summary: ASairanCharacter serves as hub with 8+ modular ActorComponent instances (Combat, Targeting, Grapple, Clone, Checkpoint, WeaponLerp, Interaction, ProceduralLimbs, Ultimate).
memories.content: The player character (ASairanCharacter) inherits from ACharacter and contains independent, decoupled components: UCombatComponent (attack/parry/block logic), UTargetingComponent (enemy detection and snap), UGrappleComponent (rope physics and aim-assist), UCloneComponent (teleport placement/activation), UCheckpointComponent (respawn point tracking), UWeaponLerpComponent (smooth weapon animation lerping between combo points), UInteractionComponent (context-sensitive object interaction), UProceduralLimbsComponent (Rayman-style spring-simulated hands/feet), UUltimateComponent (XP bar and laser attack). Each component is independently testable and replaceable. This avoids monolithic character class and enables designers to iterate individual systems without affecting others.

memories.title: Source Code Structure and Folder Organization
memories.summary: Public headers in Source/SairanSkies/Public/ organized by domain: AI/, Animation/, Character/, Combat/, Core/, Enemies/, Interaction/, Navigation/, Pickups/, Puzzles/, UI/, Weapons/. Private implementations mirror public structure.
memories.content: Directory hierarchy: Source/SairanSkies/Public/AI/ contains EnemyAIController, GroupCombatManager (World Subsystem), and behavior tree tasks/services/decorators. Animation/ has Anim Notifies and anim instances. Character/ has SairanCharacter, CloneComponent, CheckpointComponent, ProceduralLimbsComponent, UltimateComponent. Combat/ has CombatComponent, GrappleComponent, TargetingComponent. Core/ has SairanGameMode, DeathZone. Enemies/ has EnemyBase, NormalEnemy, EnemyTypes configs, DamageNumberComponent. UI/ has HUD widgets. Weapons/ has WeaponBase, Greatsword, GrappleHookActor, WeaponLerpComponent. Each .h has corresponding .cpp in Private/ with identical folder layout.

memories.title: Enemy AI: Behavior Tree + Perception + Two-Circle Combat Model
memories.summary: Enemies use Behavior Trees with AI Perception (sight/hearing), state machine (Idle→Patrolling→Investigating→Chasing→OuterCircle→InnerCircle→Attacking→Dead), and GroupCombatManager (World Subsystem) enforcing 'two circles' for realistic group combat.
memories.content: Each enemy (AEnemyBase) is controlled by AEnemyAIController running a Behavior Tree. Perception uses UAISenseConfig_Sight and UAISenseConfig_Hearing with configurable radii. State enum: EEnemyState (Idle, Patrolling, Investigating, Chasing, OuterCircle, InnerCircle, Attacking, Conversing, Dead). GroupCombatManager (UE World Subsystem) implements 'two-circle' mechanic: outer circle (~5m radius) where 3+ enemies wait and taunt, inner circle (attack range) where max 3 enemies actively attack simultaneously. Enemies request inner-circle entry; if granted, they position randomly within min/max distance and attack. After attack, they decide (55% chance) to stay or retreat to outer circle, freeing a slot for next attacker. This prevents 5-on-1 dogpile; instead creates dynamic, readable combat flow. BT tasks include AttackTarget, ChaseTarget, CircleTarget, IdleBehavior, Investigate, FindPatrolPoint, OuterCircleBehavior, WaitAtPatrolPoint.

memories.title: Enemy Configuration System: Five Config Structs
memories.summary: Each enemy configured via FEnemyCombatConfig, FEnemyPerceptionConfig, FEnemyPatrolConfig, FEnemyBehaviorConfig, FEnemyConversationConfig; plus animation/sound/VFX configs.
memories.content: EnemyTypes.h defines data-driven configuration: FEnemyCombatConfig (OuterCircleRadius=500 ± 80, MinAttackDist=100–200, BaseDamage, AttackCooldown, AllyDetectionRadius, MaxSimultaneousAttackers, MinAlliesForAggression); FEnemyPerceptionConfig (SightRadius=2000, PeripheralVisionAngle=90°, HearingRadius=1000, ProximityRadius=300, LoseSightTime=5s, InvestigationTime=10s); FEnemyPatrolConfig (PatrolSpeedMultiplier=0.25, ChaseSpeedMultiplier=0.5); FEnemyBehaviorConfig (natural pauses, look-around behavior); FEnemyConversationConfig (enemy-to-enemy chat when idle). Each config struct is BlueprintReadWrite, allowing designers to tune enemy difficulty/behavior without recompiling.

memories.title: Natural Enemy Behavior: Random Pauses, Look-Around, Conversation
memories.summary: Enemies pause randomly during patrol (flinching/scratching), look around (head rotates smoothly), and initiate conversations with nearby allies when idle (non-combat animation gestures, no voice).
memories.content: To avoid robotic AI, AEnemyBase implements: (1) StartRandomPause/EndRandomPause — enemy pauses 1–3 seconds at random intervals during patrol; (2) StartLookAround/StopLookAround — head/body rotates to scan environment, returns to patrol; (3) Conversation system — when two idle enemies are nearby, one initiates TryStartConversation, both enter Conversing state, perform synchronized hand gestures (PerformConversationGesture), face each other, then return to patrol. Conversation duration is randomized. These behaviors run in background via Tick() and behavior tree checks, making enemy patrols feel alive and unpredictable, closer to AAA enemy behavior (e.g., Arkham, Soulslike).

memories.title: Player Movement: Directional Gravity, Double Jump, Dash with I-Frames
memories.summary: Player can walk/run (toggle via L3/Shift), double-jump with variable gravity (2.5x falling, 1.5x normal), dash 600 cm in direction of movement with 0.25s duration + 0.4s cooldown, and gains i-frames during dash.
memories.content: Movement handled in ASairanCharacter: WalkSpeed=400 cm/s, RunSpeed=800 cm/s, DashDistance=600 cm, DashDuration=0.25s, DashCooldown=0.4s, MaxJumps=2, FallingGravityScale=2.5, NormalGravityScale=1.5. Jump input triggers air momentum; second jump available if in air. Gravity dynamically switches between falling/normal based on velocity. Dash input launches character in last movement input direction with impulse; bIsDashing flag grants i-frames (invulnerability) for dodging. Camera adjusts distance: DefaultCameraDistance=350 cm, RunningCameraDistance=450 cm (springs smoothly via CameraZoomSpeed=5.0).

memories.title: Combat Component: Combo System, Parry Window, Hit Detection Notify
memories.summary: UCombatComponent manages 5-hit light combo, heavy/charged attack, parry with Sekiro-style perfect window (triggers slow-mo), and hit detection gated by animation notify AN_EnableHitDetection.
memories.content: LightAttack() increments combo counter (0–4), plays corresponding montage, weapon lerps to combo point (handled by UWeaponLerpComponent). IncrementCombo() advances state; ResetCombo() on timeout (configurable window). HeavyAttack can be tapped (weak) or held (charged, scales damage). PerformParry() checks IsInParryWindow flag — if true during incoming damage window, HandleIncomingDamage() returns full block, applies slow-mo via UGameplayStatics::SetGlobalTimeDilation (0.1 scale, 0.3s duration), plays freeze-frame sound. Hit detection enabled only via animation notify AN_EnableHitDetection during attack frames; prevents multihit bugs. Delegates: FOnAttackPerformed, FOnParrySuccess, FOnHitLanded broadcast to UI and effects systems.

memories.title: Weapon System: Swing Trail (Lies of P Style), Dual Attachment Points
memories.summary: AWeaponBase features normal white/blue swing trail + blood red trail on hit (both render simultaneously), and three attachment points: hand (combat), back (sheathed), block (stance).
memories.content: Greatsword (AGreatsword extends AWeaponBase) has UStaticMeshComponent mesh, UBoxComponent hit collision. Swing trails use Niagara: ActivateSwingTrail() spawns NormalSwingTrailFX at swing start; on enemy hit, BloodSwingTrailFX spawns layered over normal trail — both trails continue emitting until particles expire (not cut). This mimics Lies of P blood/slash effect. Weapon repositions via three USceneComponent attach points: WeaponHandAttachPoint (held in hand during combat), WeaponBackAttachPoint (diagonal across back when drawn but idle), WeaponBlockAttachPoint (raised block stance). DrawWeapon()/SheathWeapon() lerps weapon between attach points. WeaponLerpComponent adds secondary motion: during combo, weapon additionally lerps to dedicated combo-point transforms (LightAttackPoint1–5, HeavyAttackPoint1–2) for rhythm-game-like visuals.

memories.title: Ultimate Component: 5-Second Laser Attack with XP Bar
memories.summary: XP bar fills on kills (25 XP per kill, 4 kills full); when full, player activates ultimate for 5-second laser that fires line traces at 3 ticks/sec (0.33s interval), dealing 35–55 damage per tick to all hit actors.
memories.content: UUltimateComponent tracks CurrentXP (starts 0, max 100). AEnemyBase::Die() calls AddXP(25), triggering HUD update. When CurrentXP ≥ MaxXP, IsReady()=true. TryActivate() locks player movement (can still rotate with camera), spawns LaserBeamComponent (Niagara) from player origin toward forward direction, runs 5-second loop (configurable LaserDuration). Each DamageInterval (0.33s), shoots line trace from camera forward to 3000cm range (LaserRange), applies random damage[DamageMin, DamageMax] to all hit actors. Beam VFX scales Z-axis only (not XY) based on trace distance to avoid growing sidewise; positioned at midpoint between trace start/end so it extends forward naturally. On hit, impacts spawn LaserImpactVFX (Niagara burst). After 5s, laser ends, movement restored, XP bar empties, cooldown triggers (if any). Ultimate can be activated via dedicated button or L3+R3 simultaneous press (combo). SFX: ActivateSound, LaserLoopSound (looped during laser), DeactivateSound.

memories.title: Procedural Limbs Component: Rayman-Style Spring-Simulated Hands and Feet
memories.summary: Body is sphere, hands are spheres (follow weapon or idle swing), feet are cones pointing down (gait driven by locomotion speed via sine wave oscillation). No skeletal animation; all procedural spring IK.
memories.content: UProceduralLimbsComponent creates 5 static meshes at runtime: BodySphere (55 cm radius), RightHand, LeftHand, RightFoot (cone tip-down), LeftFoot (cone tip-down). During tick, hands position via VInterpTo (spring-like follow) to weapon attachment points when armed, or oscillate in idle idle-sway animation when unarmed. Feet position computed from capsule bottom, oscillate vertically with sine curve (frequency varies by movement speed: faster movement = faster oscillation). Bone structure is purely visual — no hitbox changes. Requires skeleton (SKM_Tash_model) with 11 bones: Root, Hombro_der/izq → Codo_der/izq → Mano_der/izq, Rodilla_der/izq → Pie_der/izq. Bone names configurable in Blueprint. Provides distinctive Rayman-like silhouette without complex skeletal setup.

memories.title: Clone/Teleport Component: Contextual Distance, Pushback Force, Ceiling Clearance
memories.summary: PlaceClone() at current position (applies backward impulse 800 cm/s), TeleportToClone() if within MaxTeleportDistance (2000cm combat / 5000cm exploration). Clone lasts 300s, destroyed on teleport.
memories.content: UCloneComponent manages clone lifecycle. PlaceClone() spawns translucent clone actor (40% opacity) at player location, pushes player backward (PushBackForce=800), resets double-jump (mechanical advantage). State machine: Inactive (no clone) → CloneActive (clone exists, awaiting teleport). IsWithinTeleportRange() checks distance against MaxTeleportDistanceCombat (20m, weapon drawn) or MaxTeleportDistanceExplore (50m, sheathed) — contextual since combat requires proximity, exploration allows long-range. MinCeilingClearance (200cm) prevents ceiling-clipping on placement. TeleportToClone() instantly moves player to clone location, destroys clone, suppresses landing SFX via bSuppressLandingSFX flag. Delegates: FOnClonePlaced, FOnTeleported, FOnCloneExpired broadcast placement/teleport events to UI/effects.

memories.title: Team System and Perception: Enemies (ID=1) vs Player (ID=0)
memories.summary: AEnemyAIController sets team ID=1 (TEAM_ENEMIES), SairanCharacter team ID=0 (TEAM_PLAYER), enabling AI Perception to differentiate allies from player automatically.
memories.content: AAIController::GetGenericTeamId() returns FGenericTeamId(1) for enemies, Sairan returns 0. GetTeamAttitudeTowards(Other) checks team affiliation: enemies are Neutral/Hostile to player, allies to each other. UAIPerceptionComponent uses this to segregate stimuli — perception events only trigger for actors outside own team. This avoids need for manual enemy filtering in behavior trees and scales well as enemy count increases.

projects.purpose: Generador web de prompts JSON y imágenes para prendas de e-commerce usando Stable Diffusion XL

memories.title: Propósito y Casos de Uso del Proyecto
memories.summary: Aplicación web para generar automáticamente prompts JSON optimizados y fotografías profesionales de prendas de ropa para catálogos e-commerce, usando Stable Diffusion XL con parámetros técnicos consistentes.
memories.content: AIgenerator es una aplicación web especializada en generación de contenido visual para e-commerce de moda. Los casos de uso principales incluyen: 1) Generar catálogos e-commerce con fotografías consistentes de prendas, 2) Crear lookbooks de colecciones visuales, 3) Visualizar mockups de diseños antes de producción, 4) Generar contenido para redes sociales, 5) Prototipos rápidos de combinaciones de colores y estilos. La aplicación integra un 'master JSON' con parámetros profesionales de fotografía de producto (iluminación de estudio 5500K, fondo neutro #f5f5f5, cámara 50mm f/8 ISO 100, presentación en maniquí invisible, semilla fija 300321).

memories.title: Stack Tecnológico y Arquitectura de Dos Servidores
memories.summary: Backend Express.js (Node.js) con dos variantes: server.js genera prompts JSON localmente sin API externa, server-replicate.js integra Replicate para generación real de imágenes (SDXL). Frontend vanilla JS con CSS moderno (grid, animations, glassmorphism).
memories.content: Stack: Node.js + Express 5.1, CORS habilitado, body-parser para JSON. Frontend: HTML5, CSS3 (variables CSS, gradientes, animaciones Keyframe), vanilla JavaScript sin frameworks. Las dos variantes de servidor: 1) server.js (modo actual): recibe parámetros de prenda (categoría, tipo/detalle, color) y genera únicamente el prompt JSON estructurado con todos los parámetros técnicos, SIN llamar a APIs de generación de imágenes. 2) server-replicate.js (alternativo): versión que sí genera imágenes reales usando API de Replicate (Stability AI SDXL) con inference steps 50, guidance_scale 7.5, scheduler K_EULER, refine expert_ensemble_refiner. Ambos servidores escuchan en puerto 3000.

memories.title: Estructura de Carpetas y Responsabilidades
memories.summary: Raíz contiene servidores (server.js, server-replicate.js), carpeta 'public/' alberga interfaz web (index.html, app.js, styles.css), package.json define dependencias, archivos .md documenten APIs e instalación.
memories.content:
Estructura del proyecto:
- Raíz: server.js (generador de prompts JSON), server-replicate.js (generador de imágenes con Replicate), package.json (dependencias: @huggingface/inference, express, cors, body-parser, dotenv, replicate), .env (variables de entorno API keys)
- public/: index.html (interfaz HTML single-page con dos paneles: configuración y resultados), app.js (lógica frontend, 303 líneas: generación de prompts, preview en tiempo real, descargas, local save), styles.css (diseño moderno con tema cyberpunk: colores #00f0ff, #7c3aed, gradientes, animaciones)
- Documentación: README.md (guía de uso), HUGGINGFACE_SETUP.md (obtener API key HF), SOLUCION_API.md (troubleshooting y alternativas: Replicate, local AUTOMATIC1111)
- Rutas de guardado configuradas en servidores: prompts JSON → C:\Users\USER\CARRERA\Workspace\LaundryClub\assets\prompts, imágenes → C:\Users\USER\CARRERA\Workspace\LaundryClub\assets\img

memories.title: Parámetros Técnicos del Master JSON de Fotografía
memories.summary: Master JSON implementa 6 secciones profesionales: Subject (prenda: categoría, tipo, color, material lana peinada, talla M, planchado), Composition (maniquí invisible, frontal, moderado negativo, centrado), Background (neutro profesional #f5f5f5, degradado suave, sombras), Lighting (difuso estudio, 5500K, 1:1.5 key:fill), Camera (50mm focal, f/8, ISO 100, nivel ojos), Consistency (seed 300321, sRGB, 4:5 aspect, 3000x2400px, 80px safety borders).
memories.content: El JSON generado estructura todos los parámetros fotográficos con 3 secciones adicionales: styling_rules (prenda estirada, costuras nítidas, color uniforme, sin modelo, sin etiquetas), brand_safety_negative_prompt (evita logotipos, marcas, textos, patrones protegidos), quality_negative_prompt (evita artefactos, moiré, desenfoque, ruido, viñeteo). El prompt final resultante es una frase en inglés tipo: 'Professional studio product photography of [tipoDetalle] [categoria] in [color] color made of worsted wool. Presentation on invisible mannequin with front view...' que se puede usar directamente en cualquier herramienta SDXL (Automatic1111, ComfyUI, Replicate, APIs).

memories.title: Flujo de Interacción y Endpoints API
memories.summary: Frontend captura 3 inputs de usuario (categoría, tipo/detalle, color), envía POST a /api/generate, recibe JSON estructurado, lo muestra, permite copiar prompt, descargar JSON, o guardar localmente con /api/save-local.
memories.content: Endpoints principales en ambos servidores: POST /api/generate recibe {categoria, tipoDetalle, colorPrincipal} y retorna {success, promptJSON (objeto completo), promptText, negativePrompt}. POST /api/save-local recibe {promptJSON, filename} y guarda el archivo en disco (en server.js, configurado para guardar en C:\...\LaundryClub\assets\prompts). GET /api/health verifica salud del servidor. El flujo frontend: 1) Input en tiempo real → updatePromptPreview() actualiza preview de prompt 2) Clic botón 'Generar Imagen' → POST /api/generate 3) Respuesta muestra JSON formateado en <pre>, metadata, botones de acción 4) Usuario puede copiar prompt al portapapeles, descargar JSON, o guardar localmente. En server-replicate.js, /api/generate además genera imagen real (base64) y /api/save-local guarda PNG. Requests incluyen origen correcto para CORS.

memories.title: Dependencias y Proveedores de API
memories.summary: npm: express 5.1, @huggingface/inference 4.11.3, replicate 1.3.0, cors, body-parser, dotenv. API keys: REPLICATE_API_TOKEN (preferido, más estable) o HF_API_KEY (Hugging Face alternativa).
memories.content: Dependencias de npm en package.json: express 5.1.0 (servidor HTTP), @huggingface/inference 4.11.3 (cliente para APIs de Hugging Face, no usado actualmente en server.js pero disponible), cors 2.8.5 (habilitar CORS), body-parser 2.2.0 (parsear JSON), dotenv 17.2.3 (cargar variables de entorno desde .env), replicate 1.3.0 (cliente para API de Replicate, solo en server-replicate.js). Modelos de IA: Stability AI SDXL en Replicate (modelo ID: stability-ai/sdxl:39ed52f2a78e934b3ba6e2a89f5b1c712de7dfea535525255b1aa35c5565e08b). Autenticación: REPLICATE_API_TOKEN y HF_API_KEY en .env (no commiteado, archivo en .gitignore).

memories.title: Interfaz de Usuario y Experiencias de Usuario
memories.summary: Panel izquierdo de configuración (3 inputs texto: categoría, tipo/detalle, color), panel derecho con preview de prompt/negative-prompt en tiempo real, área de resultados con JSON formateado. Botones de acción: Descargar JSON, Guardar Local, Copiar Prompt. Metadata: categoría, detalle, color, seed, material, presentación, encuadre.
memories.content: UI implementada con glassmorphism moderno: header animado con gradiente cyan-purple (#00f0ff, #7c3aed), dos paneles en grid responsive. Panel izquierdo (config-panel): h2 '🎯 Configuración de Prenda', 3 inputs texto con placeholders en español, info-box con parámetros fijos (Material: Lana Peinada, Presentación: Maniquí Invisible, Encuadre: Frontal, Fondo, Iluminación, Cámara). Botón '⚡ Generar Imagen' con spinner animado que aparece durante generación (30-60 seg esperado). Panel derecho (result-panel): preview de prompts en boxes oscuros (#0a0e27), imageContainer muestra JSON formateado en <pre> con sintaxis, imageActions (3 botones: Descargar 💾, Guardar Local 📁, Copiar Prompt 📋), metadata section con tabla de valores generados. Todas las animaciones y transiciones usan CSS Keyframes, sin librerías externas.

memories.title: Parámetros de Configuración SDXL y Generación de Imágenes
memories.summary: Inference steps 50, guidance_scale 7.5, scheduler K_EULER, refine expert_ensemble_refiner, seed fijo 300321, resoluciones 768x1024 a 1280x1024, output PNG. Brand safety: negative prompts previenen logos, marcas, textos, etiquetas.
memories.content: Los parámetros técnicos para generación en server-replicate.js están optimizados para fotografía de producto de e-commerce: num_inference_steps: 50 (balance calidad-velocidad), guidance_scale: 7.5 (adhere fuerte al prompt sin artefactos), scheduler: K_EULER (sampler estable), refine: expert_ensemble_refiner (post-procesamiento de calidad), seed: 300321 (consistencia reproducible). Resoluciones soportadas: 768x1024, 1024x1024, 1280x1024 (portrait para moda). Brand safety implementado con negative_prompt_final que incluye exclusiones: 'logos, brands, text, labels, wrinkles, moiré, artifacts, noise, vignetting, blur, people, accessories, complex background'. Formato salida: PNG base64 (embebido en respuesta JSON como data:image/png;base64,...), puede guardarse localmente.

memories.title: Estado Actual: Modo Generador de Prompts (No Generación Real)
memories.summary: Actualmente server.js genera solo prompts JSON sin llamar a APIs de imagen. Alternativa server-replicate.js disponible pero requiere API token de Replicate. Documentación de troubleshooting en SOLUCION_API.md: Replicate preferido, Hugging Face como alternativa, local AUTOMATIC1111 como opción offline.
memories.content: El servidor actual (server.js) es un generador de prompts JSON puro que NO genera imágenes reales. Simplemente estructura los parámetros de entrada en un JSON profesional que puede exportarse y usarse en herramientas externas. La documentación SOLUCION_API.md explica dos problemas históricos: 1) API key de Hugging Face caducada/inválida → solución es usar Replicate (más estable) o generar nuevo token HF, 2) Replicate como opción preferida (más confiable que Hugging Face Inference API). Se proporciona server-replicate.js como alternativa que SÍ genera imágenes reales usando API de Replicate, pero requiere configurar REPLICATE_API_TOKEN en .env. Para usar offline sin APIs, la guía sugiere Automatic1111 WebUI local (https://github.com/AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui) apuntando a http://localhost:7860.
